get.description: No auth: anonymous visitors and not-yet-signed-in apps need it too.

post.description:
Log in as a dev user and set the session cookie (development only).

Without ``user`` this is the fixed dev user; with it, a separate user per key —
e2e tests use one per test so parallel runs never share lists or rate limits.

parameters.name: user

schema.description: Optional dev user key (1-64 of a-z, 0-9, '-'). Each key is a separate user; omit it for the shared fixed dev user.
schema.title: User

parameters.description: Optional dev user key (1-64 of a-z, 0-9, '-'). Each key is a separate user; omit it for the shared fixed dev user.

get.description:
Begin the real login flow: redirect to Cognito's hosted UI (straight to Google).

Stashes a signed state cookie (CSRF token + nonce + PKCE verifier + the safe
post-login redirect) that ``/callback`` reads back to finish the exchange.

Finish the login flow: verify the returned id token and mint a session.

On any failure we redirect the browser to the frontend login page with a
generic ``?error=`` flag (details are logged, never leaked to the URL).

schema.title: Response Logout Api V1 Auth Logout Post

get.description: Return the authenticated user (401 if not logged in).

Return the current user's non-deleted lists (401 if not logged in).

``q``, if given, filters to lists whose title or any tag matches (case-insensitive
substring) — see ``list_service.list_for_user``.

schema.title: Response Read Lists Api V1 Lists Get

post.description:
Create a new list owned by the current user (401 if not logged in).

409 if the account already has ``max_lists_per_user`` lists.

Upload lists kept on a device to the current user's account (401 if not
logged in) — the claim after sign-in. See ``list_import_service``.

All or nothing: 422 with a ``detail`` naming the list if any list breaks a rule,
or if the upload would take the account past ``max_lists_per_user`` (nothing is
written). 413 if the upload has more than ``max_lists_per_import`` lists, or the
body is over ``max_import_bytes`` (checked by ``BodySizeLimitMiddleware`` as it
arrives). Idempotent: a retry returns the lists the first attempt made, as
``already_imported``.

get.description: Return one of the current user's lists (404 if missing, not theirs, or deleted).

patch.description: Rename one of the current user's lists (404 if missing, not theirs, or deleted).

delete.description:
Soft-delete one of the current user's lists (404 if missing, not theirs, or deleted).

A second delete of the same id is still 404 — the row is invisible to
`get_owned_list` once `deleted_at` is set, same as any other soft-deleted row.

put.description:
Replace one of the current user's lists' full tag set (404 if missing, not
theirs, or deleted).

422 if the submitted set (after de-duplication) exceeds the per-list tag cap.

get.description: Return one of the current user's lists' items, in rank order.

schema.title: Response Read Items Api V1 Lists  List Id  Items Get

post.description:
Append a new item to the end of one of the current user's lists.

409 if the list is already at the item cap, or another item in this list
already has this text (case-insensitive).

patch.description:
Edit an item's text/note/image (404 if missing, not theirs, or in a different list).

409 if another item in this list already has this text (case-insensitive).

delete.description:
Delete an item and repack the remaining ranks.

404 if missing, not theirs, or in a different list.

patch.description:
Move an item to a new 1-based rank, shifting the rest; returns the full new order.

422 if the position isn't within the list's current item range.

schema.title: Response Reorder Item Api V1 Lists  List Id  Items  Item Id  Position Patch

get.description: Product, analytics, health and cost numbers. Aggregates only; cached ~5 minutes.

schema.title: Before

Sign the user out on every device (they can sign back in).

get.description: Every runtime setting, its default and bounds, and its current value.

Record a batch of product events. The user id comes from the session cookie.

AdminAction.title: AdminAction
AdminAction.description: Body of a mutating admin action: an optional note for the audit log.

AdminListSummary.title: AdminListSummary
AdminListSummary.description: A list as the admin sees it: deleted ones included, and who deleted them.

AdminReasonRequired.title: AdminReasonRequired
AdminReasonRequired.description: Body of an action that must say why (removing someone's content).

AdminUserSummary.title: AdminUserSummary
AdminUserSummary.description: A user as the admin sees them in search results.

ImportedItem.title: ImportedItem
ImportedItem.description: One item, in rank order. Its ``local_id`` is ignored: items get server ids.

ImportedListRead.title: ImportedListRead
ImportedListRead.description: What became of one uploaded list, in the order they were sent.

ItemCreate.title: ItemCreate
ItemCreate.description:
Body for ``POST /api/lists/{list_id}/items``.

``position`` is never part of this schema: a new item always lands at the end of
the list — the position is computed server-side in the service layer.

ItemRead.title: ItemRead
ItemRead.description: An item as returned by the API (e.g. ``GET /api/lists/{list_id}/items``).

ItemReorder.title: ItemReorder
ItemReorder.description:
Body for ``PATCH /api/lists/{list_id}/items/{item_id}/position``.

``position`` is a 1-based rank; whether it's actually in range for the list
depends on how many items exist, which this schema can't see — that check
happens in ``list_item_service.reorder_item``.

ItemUpdate.title: ItemUpdate
ItemUpdate.description:
Body for ``PATCH /api/lists/{list_id}/items/{item_id}``.

Full-replace, like ``ListUpdate`` — all three fields are sent together from one
edit form, not a partial/merge patch. ``position`` isn't settable here; use the
dedicated reorder endpoint (``ItemReorder``) instead.

ListCreate.title: ListCreate
ListCreate.description:
Body for ``POST /api/lists`` — the only user-settable field is the title.

``user_id`` is never part of this schema: the owner always comes from the
session (``current_user.id``), never the request body.

ListRead.title: ListRead
ListRead.description: A list as returned by the API (e.g. ``GET /api/lists``).

ListUpdate.title: ListUpdate
ListUpdate.description: Body for ``PATCH /api/lists/{list_id}`` — rename only, same rules as create.

ListsImport.title: ListsImport
ListsImport.description: Body for ``POST /api/lists/import``. The owner is always the caller.

SettingRead.title: SettingRead
SettingRead.description: One runtime setting on the admin Settings page.

SettingUpdate.title: SettingUpdate
SettingUpdate.description: Checked against the setting's own type and bounds, strictly (no ``1`` for true).

TagsUpdate.title: TagsUpdate
TagsUpdate.description:
Body for ``PUT /api/lists/{list_id}/tags`` — replaces a list's full tag set.

Each entry is normalized (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, lower-cased) the same
way ``tag_service.set_list_tags`` would need to anyway, so the set that reaches
the service is already de-dupeable by plain equality.

UserRead.title: UserRead
UserRead.description: A user as returned by the API (e.g. ``GET /me``).
